mapper.insert: insert into search_keyword_pool(keyword,search_count,click_count,status,source,last_search_time,create_time,update_time) values(#{keyword.keyword},#{keyword.searchCount},#{keyword.clickCount},#{keyword.status},#{keyword.source},NOW(),NOW(),NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE search_count = search_count + 1, last_search_time = NOW()
